setup.shell:
set -euo pipefail
mkdir -p "$HOME/Movies/Muselet Demo/run"
cp "$HOME/Movies/Muselet Demo/Muselet Demo template.prproj" "$HOME/Movies/Muselet Demo/run/Muselet Demo run.prproj"
open -a "Adobe Premiere Pro" "$HOME/Movies/Muselet Demo/run/Muselet Demo run.prproj"
for _ in $(seq 1 90); do
  titles="$(osascript -e 'tell application "System Events" to tell first application process whose bundle identifier starts with "com.adobe.PremierePro" to get name of every window' 2>/dev/null || true)"
  case "$titles" in *"Muselet Demo run"*) echo "opened"; exit 0;; esac
  sleep 1
done
echo "Premiere project window did not open" >&2
exit 1

teardown.applescript:
tell application "System Events"
try
 set p to first application process whose bundle identifier starts with "com.adobe.PremierePro"
 set frontmost of p to true
 keystroke "q" using {command down}
 repeat 40 times
  try
   if exists button "Don't Save" of sheet 1 of window 1 of p then click button "Don't Save" of sheet 1 of window 1 of p
   if exists button "Don't Save" of window 1 of p then click button "Don't Save" of window 1 of p
   if exists button "No" of sheet 1 of window 1 of p then click button "No" of sheet 1 of window 1 of p
   if exists button "No" of window 1 of p then click button "No" of window 1 of p
  end try
  if not (exists p) then exit repeat
  delay 0.25
 end repeat
 return "quit requested for case-created Premiere process"
on error messageText
 return messageText
end try
end tell

teardown.shell:
for _ in $(seq 1 30); do
  running="$(osascript -e 'tell application "System Events" to return (count of (application processes whose bundle identifier starts with "com.adobe.PremierePro")) > 0' 2>/dev/null || echo true)"
  if test "$running" = "false"; then
    rm -f "$HOME/Desktop/Muselet Demo.mp4" "$HOME/Movies/Muselet Demo/run/Muselet Demo run.prproj"
    exit 0
  fi
  sleep 1
done
echo "Premiere did not quit; left case-created files untouched" >&2
exit 1
